nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 liquidity asset token held in escrow by FundingLocker.
Immutable address of the Loan contract authorized to pull or drain funds.
FundingLocker constructor that sets liquidityAsset and loan immutables.
External isLoan-gated function transferring a chosen amount of liquidity asset to an arbitrary destination.
External isLoan-gated function transferring the entire token balance of the locker to the Loan.
Caller address used by the isLoan modifier to gate privileged functions.
liquidityAsset.safeTransfer(dst, amt) external token call inside pull, transferring to an attacker-influenced destination.
liquidityAsset.safeTransfer(loan, amt) external token call inside drain after reading the locker balance.
Constructor parameter holding the liquidity asset token address.
Constructor parameter holding the authorized Loan address.
Destination address parameter of pull, fully controlled by the calling Loan.
Amount parameter of pull, fully controlled by the calling Loan.
Local variable in drain set to liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)) prior to transfer.

edges.reason: isLoan modifier requires msg.sender == loan before pull body executes, so caller identity gates the privileged transfer.
isLoan modifier requires msg.sender == loan before drain body executes, gating the full-balance sweep.
loan state variable is compared with msg.sender in the isLoan modifier wrapping pull.
loan state variable is compared with msg.sender in the isLoan modifier wrapping drain.
Constructor parameter _liquidityAsset is assigned to the liquidityAsset immutable.
Constructor parameter _loan is assigned to the loan immutable.
pull destination parameter dst flows into the safeTransfer recipient argument.
pull amount parameter amt flows into the safeTransfer value argument.
liquidityAsset token state variable is the call target of the safeTransfer in pull.
liquidityAsset token state variable is the call target of the safeTransfer in drain.
drain reads liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)) to size the transfer.
loan state variable is the recipient of the whole balance in drain.
Local amt computed from balanceOf flows into the safeTransfer value in drain.
External token transfer in pull passes control to token/recipient code, which can re-enter pull before the call returns.
External token transfer in drain passes control to token code after the balance read, allowing re-entrant drain.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only exists to initialize the liquidityAsset immutable, so it collapses into the constructor core node.
Constructor parameter only exists to initialize the loan immutable, so it collapses into the constructor core node.
Destination parameter is consumed directly by the safeTransfer external call in pull.
Amount parameter is consumed directly by the safeTransfer external call in pull.
Local amt is a transient balance value passed straight into the safeTransfer external call in drain.
